wu: Play 'Simon Says' with family vocabulary: 'Simon says touch your mother', 'Simon says show me your sister', 'Simon says point to your brother'.
wuAlt: Play 'Pass the Parcel' with family flashcards; child says 'This is my...' when music stops
Play 'Flashcard Jump' - kids jump to flashcard of mother/father/sister/baby and name it
pres: Use a large family tree poster; point to each person and say 'This is my mother', 'This is my father'; then add 'This is my mother's book' with a small book prop; check understanding by asking 'Who is this?' and 'Whose book is this?'
presAlt: Use a puppet family; puppet introduces each member and says 'This is my...'; kids repeat
Show a family photo album; teacher says 'This is my sister's doll' as kids look at photos
prac: Pair drill with mini family trees; Student A points to a person and says 'This is my...', Student B says 'This is my... too' or 'This is my father's car' with a car prop; teacher monitors and corrects pronunciation
pracAlt: Play 'Family Bingo' with pictures; kids cover 'mother' when teacher says 'This is my mother'
Play 'Chain Game' - first kid says 'This is my mother', next says 'This is my mother and this is my father'
ls: Play 'Listen and Draw' - teacher describes a family tree ('This is my father. This is my mother's cat. This is my brother's ball') and kids draw what they hear; check drawings in pairs
re: Play 'Family Statues' - teacher calls 'Mother!' kids pose as mothers, 'Father!' kids pose as fathers, etc.; fastest movers get stickers
prod: Make a mini-book with 4 pages; kids draw their family and write 'This is my mother', 'This is my father', etc.; read their book to a partner using 'This is my...'
rw: Trace family words (mother, father, sister, brother) with dotted lines, then copy them 3 times; write one sentence like 'This is my mother' in their notebooks
st: Sing 'The Family Song' with actions (hands on hips for mother, big muscles for father, etc.); end with Goodbye Song + sticker chart + high-five line
g: Match family member cards with their objects (e.g., father's car)
One child describes a family member (e.g., 'This is my sister's doll') and others guess
Teams race to place flashcards in correct family tree positions
Teacher removes a family member from the poster and kids say 'This is my mother's...?'
Pass a family flashcard and say 'This is my...' when music stops
diff: Fast finishers: Draw an extra family member and write 'This is my...'
Support: Trace dotted words and use word bank for writing
hw: Read your mini-book to your family
Draw a picture of your family and label 3 members
Ask your family 'Who is this?' and write down 3 names
tip: Use Moroccan family photos (e.g., with grandparents, cousins) to make the theme relatable; praise kids for using full sentences even if pronunciation isn't perfect.
